alt: Snow-covered Mount Adams viewed from the Naches Loop Trail in Washington.
caption: Mount Adams, Washington. This Cascade arc volcano is part of the volcanic chain above the Cascadia subduction zone.

credit: Rich Keen / DPRA / USFWS · public domain · resized
alt: Denver's skyline and distant mountain slopes seen from Rocky Mountain Arsenal National Wildlife Refuge.
caption: Denver, Colorado. The city stands on high plains beside the Rocky Mountains; elevation reduces air pressure compared with sea level.

credit: NOAA Corps aerial survey: Mark Moran, Phil Eastman and Dave Demers · public domain · 2005 · resized
alt: Flooded streets and houses in New Orleans after Hurricane Katrina in 2005.
caption: New Orleans after Hurricane Katrina, 2005. Floodwater filled low-lying neighbourhoods after storm surge and flood-protection failures.

alt: Visitors and a park ranger stand in the broad limestone Broadway passage of Mammoth Cave, Kentucky.
caption: Broadway passage, Mammoth Cave, Kentucky. Groundwater dissolution enlarged fractures in limestone into a large cave system.

alt: Satellite view of Typhoon Mangkhut with a compact eye and spiralling cloud bands in September 2018.
caption: Typhoon Mangkhut, September 2018, observed by NASA EOSDIS. The western North Pacific storm later affected the Philippines and southern China; this image is a historical observation.

alt: Steam and orange microbial mats around Grand Prismatic Spring in Yellowstone National Park.
caption: Grand Prismatic Spring, Yellowstone. Hot groundwater and heat-tolerant microorganisms create the pool's striking colour bands.

alt: A Deep SOLO profiling float is lowered from the research vessel Kaʻimikai-O-Kanaloa in 2018.
caption: NOAA Deep SOLO deployment, 2018. Profiling floats measure ocean temperature and salinity at depth, helping scientists study density structure and deep circulation. The ocean conveyor is a simplified description of a complex circulation.

alt: Rock contact exposed along the Moine Thrust at Knockan Crag in northwest Scotland.
caption: Moine Thrust, Knockan Crag. Caledonian compression pushed older rocks over younger rocks; the exposed contact is field evidence of that mountain-building episode.

alt: A dark Glossopteris fossil leaf from Permian rocks in Antarctica, with a branching vein network.
caption: Permian Glossopteris leaf from Antarctica. Related fossils on separated southern continents are evidence that these lands were once joined within Gondwana, which formed part of Pangaea.

alt: Panorama of Bald Eagle Mountain in Pennsylvania with the Route 15 wind gap left of centre and a water gap farther right.
caption: Bald Eagle Mountain, Pennsylvania. The wind gap crossed by Route 15 is left of centre; Hagermans Run occupies a separate water gap to the right. A wind gap lacks the through-flowing river found in a water gap.
